jobs.description:
High-Level Picker (m/w/d)
Don't have a forklift license? No problem! The employer pays 100% for your forklift license (Level 1 and Level 2). It is free for you! You just need to be willing to drive a forklift.

These are the benefits you can expect at Tempton:

- Permanent employment contract
- €17.20 per hour + shift allowances (extra pay for late and night shifts)
- Pay in accordance with the GVP collective agreement, at a minimum
- Collective-agreement bonuses for overtime, night shifts, Sundays, and public holidays
- Up to 30 days of paid vacation, depending on length of service
- Recognized social benefits, including vacation pay and Christmas bonus, as well as contributions toward company pension schemes
- Assignments at well-known client companies, offering opportunities for personal and professional development
- Possibility of being taken on permanently by the client company

Your daily responsibilities:

- Operating forklifts
- Retrieving packages from high shelves (high-bay warehouse):You operate the forklift with the cabin/platform moving upwards.You retrieve packages from the shelvesYou place the packages onto the platform.You then lower the platform and drive back down
- Working days: Monday to SaturdayIf you work on Saturday, you will have one weekday off
- Early shift: 06:00 AM – 2:21 PM
- Late shift: 2:00 PM – 10:21 PM
- Night shift: 11:00 PM – 6:21 AM (October to December only)

What you bring to the role:

- No fear of heights and able to work safely at heights
- Willingness to obtain a forklift license
- The medical examination is provided free of charge by our company doctor
- All genders are welcome!
- Basic knowledge of German or English

Does this sound like you?

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager PCC Esslingen (m/w/d)  (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our Product Competence Center Esslingen is a key part of TK Elevator’s global innovation network. On 33,000 square meters, we bring together development, production, testing facilities, and customer experience under one roof. Around 400 employees develop, manufacture, test, and qualify cutting-edge elevator technologies here – including the smart and eco-efficient EOX platform. 
Our modern training workshop allows us to educate and develop new talent at the highest quality level. In addition, we operate a fully digitalized spare parts warehouse of 5,700 square meters, supporting the maintenance of more than 250,000 elevators and escalators in TK Elevator’s global service network

What we expect

- Act as strategic partner to the Business Line Leadership Team, supporting business strategy and growth initiatives
- Analyze customer requirements, market trends and competitive developments to identify business opportunities and drive decision-making
- Drive the translation of strategic priorities into actionable plans and ensure consistent execution across the organization
- Support the continuous development and optimization of target operating models across different business areas
- Lead cross-functional projects and coordinate key stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Order Management and Field organizations
- Establish and monitor business performance indicators and derive actions to improve operational and commercial results

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate brings a strong sense of ownership, drives results with confidence and meets the following key requirements:

- University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics or a related field
- Experience in strategy, business development, management consulting, project management or a comparable leadership support role
- Experience in the elevator industry, industrial products or a comparable technical environment
- Experience in driving strategic initiatives and managing complex cross-functional projects
- Structured working style with a hands-on, pragmatic approach and strong execution capabilities
- Fluent in English and German
- Willingness to travel (approx. 30%)

What we offer

- Health and Safety –Highest standards and a wide range of health promotion and healthcare activities
- Flexibility –We support, for example, through flexible yet regulated working hours and remote working options
- Compensation und pension – Fair working conditions, competitive compensation, following “Collective Agreements” and support with pension schemes
- Collaboration und diversity –Collegiality is of huge importance – we treat everyone with respect and appreciation
- Development –Individual support to help you get started in your new job as well as training and education programs to help you develop professionally and personally
- Creative leeway –We offer an environment in which you can try out new solutions in a no-blame-culture
- Sustainability –We act with responsibility and environmental awareness
- Work environment –We have modern workplaces and IT equipment, subsidized lunchtime meals in the canteen, free parking and discounted public transport tickets

Contact

Please apply online. Carolin Hock and Johanna von WendtHuman Resources – Recruiting If you have any questions about the position or our application process, please contact us at: carolin.hock@tkelevator.com or johanna.vonwendt@tkelevator.com

Additional Information

At TK Elevator, we aim to embrace diversity and welcome everyone -no matter the ethnicity, nationality, gender or gender expression, age, social background, religion or world belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic or status.
Do you have a disability and would like to work with us? Then we look forward to your application!
As a signatory of the Charter of Diversity, TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. Although we are not completely barrier-free yet, we are working every day to improve ourselves. Let’s overcome barriers together and work on individual solutions that work for you.

jobs.occupation: Head of Analog Design (m/f/d) - Executive (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Company Description

In September 2025, AUMOVIO emerged as a spin-off from Continental’s former Automotive group sector and has since established itself as an independent technology company. The company offers a broad portfolio for safe, exciting, connected and autonomous mobility, including sensor solutions, displays, brake and comfort systems as well as extensive expertise in software, architecture platforms and advanced driver assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In fiscal year 2025, AUMOVIO generated sales of € 18.5 billion. Headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, AUMOVIO has around 82,000 employees at more than 80 locations worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking an executive leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design to lead a strategically important global organization. In this role, you will drive innovation, technology leadership, and organizational excellence while shaping next-generation semiconductor solutions for demanding automotive applications.

As Head of Analog Design (m/f/d), you will lead a global organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple locations worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and executing the organization's analog design strategy, ensuring world-class designs, engineering excellence and enabling sustainable business growth through innovative semiconductor solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

- Defining and executing the long-term Analog Design strategy aligned with business objectives
- Leading, mentoring, and developing leaders, and engineering teams across global sites
- Overseeing the complete analog IC development lifecycle from concept through production readiness
- Driving technology innovation, development excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships with design houses, universities, foundries, OSATs, and ecosystem partners
- Managing budgets, resource allocation, capability development, and organizational growth
- Influencing product portfolio decisions, technology roadmaps, and business case development
- Representing the company in industry forums, conferences, and strategic technology networks

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics, or comparable qualification
- Long term experience in semiconductor and IC development
- Experience managing substantial budgets, resources, and organizational growth
- Proven track record of bringing complex semiconductor products to mass production and building high-performing engineering organizations
- Significant leadership experience within international R&D organizations
- Demonstrated success leading diverse, geographically distributed teams
- Recognized technology and people leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog design and semiconductor technologies
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)
- Strong strategic thinking and business acumen
- Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive leadership capabilities

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

jobs.occupation: Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders) (Maschinen- und Anlagenführer/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
jobs.description:
html Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders)Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders)
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still.

THE WHAT

You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day.

Your tasks in detail:

- Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
- Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
- Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
- Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
- Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE

- Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.
- Experience: First experience in a test lab or materials testing is a plus — not a must. What matters more: you want to learn.
- Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.
- Team player: You enjoy working with others and help out when things get busy.
- Languages: German and English, each at B2 minimum — one of the two confident for daily work.
- On-site: This role is 100% on-site in Taufkirchen. The lab and test bench don't fit in a home office.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

Please refer to reference number YF-51576 for your application.

Apply for this job

jobs.occupation: Lead Backend Engineer (m/f/d), Peter Park System GmbH (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Introduction: Get ready to embark on an exhilarating journey in the world of mobility technology! This job opportunity invites you to shape the future of parking systems, where you'll be at the forefront of developing a cutting-edge backend, optimizing CI pipelines, and enhancing monitoring with Datadog, all while ensuring the seamless operation of thousands of parking lots. If you're a passionate engineer with a hunger for continuous improvement and proficiency in a variety of programming languages, this is your chance to revolutionize the industry and make a direct impact on our dynamic, tech-driven team. Your Objectives & Role: Drive the Backend Vision: Define and evolve the architecture of our backend systems, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term product strategy. Align Engineering with Strategy: Act as a technical counterpart to product and business stakeholders, translating company objectives into backend initiatives with measurable impact. Drive End-to-End Ownership: Take accountability for backend projects from concept to delivery and beyond, setting the standard for reliability and quality across the lifecycle. Champion Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for clean, performant, and maintainable code; foster a culture of high standards and technical curiosity. Lead & Develop Engineers: Guide backend engineers through mentorship, coaching, and clear technical direction to grow the team’s capabilities and autonomy. Elevate Operational Maturity: Lead improvements to monitoring, observability, and developer workflows, ensuring backend systems are resilient and teams can ship confidently. Backend Development: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, Node.js, and backend frameworks such as NestJS, Flask, Fastify, or FastAPI. Cloud Expertise: Hands-on experience with AWS services like RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, EC2, and SQS. Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform or similar tools for infrastructure automation. High-Throughput Systems: Strong experience in real production projects handling large-scale data flows. Monitoring & Observability: Proficiency in tools like Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana. Security & Networking: Solid understanding of networking principles, security best practices, and cloud security. Agile & Fast-Paced Environments: Experience in agile teams, working in dynamic, fast-growing tech environments. Excellent Communication: Strong English communication skills (C1+), with the ability to collaborate across teams. German proficiency is not required. Technologies We Work With: Event-driven backend development in Python and NestJS, following a microservice architecture Frontend monorepo with Turbo, pnpm, changesets, and storybook, primarily using Vue.js Adoption of TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ, and Prisma for backends in an opinionated monorepo approach Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, S3 Container orchestration with Kubernetes and CI/CD using GitLab Infrastructure provisioning on AWS using Terraform Leveraging the serverless framework on AWS Lambda for high-throughput endpoints Work Setup: Hours: 40 hours per week (based on trust) Home Office Policy: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote Contract: Permanent contract Location: Munich What We Offer: We believe in supporting our team with an environment that fosters growth, well-being, and a great work-life balance.Your Ideal Setup: MacBook (M4 Pro, 48GB Ram) and a 37-inch curved screen. Dynamic Culture: Enjoy a true startup atmosphere with flat hierarchies, agile teams, and a diverse, international group of colleagues. Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours and the option to work from home or our state-of-the-art Munich office with standing desks. Competitive Compensation: A strong competitive salary that recognizes your expertise. Future Planning: A solid company pension plan. Foodie Perks: Daily meal allowance, weekly free team lunch, a well-stocked cereal bar, and complimentary drinks. Health & Wellness: Job bike program and access to premium sports and fitness facilities via EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club membership across Germany. Continuous Growth: Ample professional development opportunities to sharpen your skills. Language Support: German language learning opportunities. Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy special discounts on various branded products through Corporate Benefits. Our Recruiting Process: Initial Contact: We’ll get back to you within 48 hours. HR Interview: Discuss your experience and expectations. Live Assessment: Showcase your skills in a technical challenge. CTO Interview: Deep dive into the role and expectations. On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office and meet the team.

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.

As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.

Your tasks:

- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.
- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.
- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.
- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.
- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.

Essential experience/ qualifications:

- Above the average motivation and work ethics
- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology
- English writing and speaking skills
- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another
- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalent

additional advantages:

- Experience in omics data science
- Hands-on experience in human immunology

We offer:

- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)
- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements
- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved
- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.
- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.
- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors
- High end translational research
- State-of-the-art laboratories
- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development
- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)
- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )
- Comprehensive health promotion offers
- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)
- Family-friendly enviroment

Further information:

jobs.description:
State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.

As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.

Your tasks:

- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.
- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.
- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.
- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.
- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.

Essential experience/ qualifications:

- Above the average motivation and work ethics
- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology
- English writing and speaking skills
- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another
- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalent

additional advantages:

jobs.description:
Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)
Transform the everyday.
This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.
In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.

Methodological Expertise

- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:
- Process FMEA
- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)
- 8D Problem Solving
- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
- 5 Why Analysis
- Pareto Analysis
- Process Audits
- Corrective Action Management
- Lessons Learned Processes
- Control Plans
- KPI and Performance Reviews
- Structured Escalation Processes

Communication & Collaboration

- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus
